title: Final eligible organization corpus canonical-boundary review

selectedGap.reason: This production corpus segment selects 17 of 17 currently eligible published organizations for comprehensive, review-first editorial-profile refresh without automatic activation or publication.

guardrailNotes: Private research lineage only; this zero-candidate corpus segment does not create Admin Review rows or change canonical published records.
Every selected target requires a canonical identity, lifecycle, entity-kind, successor, duplicate, or Canadian-nexus decision before editorial-profile activation.
A target count is not a publication quota; unsupported dossiers remain typed research_required outcomes rather than being padded into candidates.
